Tata Sons Prepares for IPO Amid Regulatory Pressure

Tata Sons, the holding company of the Tata Group, has begun preparations for an Initial Public Offering (IPO). This move comes after the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) classified the company as an NBFC-Upper Layer, which mandates listing within three years. Failure to comply with RBI regulations could lead to strict action, although the final decision on listing may involve shareholders.
